references.text: Moses' miracle with the manna in the wilderness, which is a foreshadowing of Jesus' miracle with the loaves and fish.
Psalm 23, where the Lord is described as a shepherd leading to green pastures, can be seen as a spiritual parallel to Jesus' act of feeding the people.
Another event where Jesus feeds a large crowd, this time with seven loaves and a few small fish.
Mark's version of the event where Jesus feeds 5,000 men with five loaves and two fish.
Luke's version of the event where Jesus feeds 5,000 men with five loaves and two fish.
John's version of the event where Jesus feeds 5,000 men with five loaves and two fish, with additional details about the boy who had the loaves and fish.
